notes: Scope: Presbytery of Philadelphia congregations in the City of Philadelphia, checked from the presbytery's Our Churches list (the first 100 entries; the page has a Load More button and the second fetch found no further Philadelphia entries, so the list may be incomplete). First Presbyterian Church in Philadelphia and First Presbyterian Church in Germantown were skipped because they are already on file, as the brief asked. First Presbyterian Church of Kensington did not resolve. First Presbyterian Church of Olney was checked and recorded. Records use the group's own site first and the presbytery list only for phone and email. Dated evidence: Oak Lane, Overbrook, Old Pine, Tabernacle, Summit and East Falls show dated 2026 items and are marked active. The rest are probably_active or active on a year-only mark, because their dates have no year or no date at all. Copyright footers were never used as evidence. UMC Eastern Pennsylvania Conference, UCC and American Baptist congregations: three searches were used. The searches found the UMC conference site (epaumc.org), the UCC Pennsylvania Southeast Conference (psec.org) and the Philadelphia Baptist Association (philadelphiabaptist.org), but no usable roster of Philadelphia congregations. Those three lanes are not covered in this file. Search budget is spent, so the next pass needs the association rosters fetched directly.
